tools.name: get_business_info

tools.name: check_service_area

tools.name: get_available_times
tools.description: Open arrival windows for the next few days (up to 21), in IN local time. If online availability is unavailable, ask the customer for a preferred day and time instead.

tools.description: Submit an appointment request. A Western Sky team member calls the customer to confirm the time; it is not final until then. Only call this after the customer has confirmed every detail.
